RE: Waterford Square 2nd Filing Final Plat
Dear Council Person:
Iam writing this letter as it ismy duty as Cheyenne City Engineer, to inform you of projects that
do not meet the Cheyenne Unified Development Code.
At the Public Services Meeting on October4,2016PS C recommended that the Waterford Square
2md Filing Final Plat be approved despite the objections of both the Planning & Engineering
Departments.I knowthat multiple staff members have spent hour's reviewing this project, together
with the developer and his engineer.We have suggested a number of ways he can correct the
deficiencies.
City Staffis not anti-development.Weare here to assure that City Code, Ordinances, and Policies
are adhered to. I took an oath to do the same.
Waterford Square 2nd Filing does not comply with our Development Code as Cheyenne does not
allowfor private roads, nor does it qualifyfor a subdivision waiver.
It is my opinion that if passed and constructed as a private alley the following will happen:
1.A precedence will be set for 20'private roadways throughout the City and soon we will
have private roads everywhere.These are muchcheaper to construct therefore allbuilders
willwant to use them in order tokeep the home sales competitive.
OFICEN

4.Traffic control and speeding may become a problem.
5.Eventually the alley will need repair and when presented with the costs, the homeowners
may very likely turn to the City to bail them out, as they have no other choice.
When allof this happens it willbe the tax payers and the City thatmust respond.At this point the
only person to benefit from having built a substandard subdivision in Cheyenne is the
Developer/Builder.
West Gate Subdivision off of Carlson is an example of this situationit used to be private roads.
Fortunately for the City they weren't 20'alleys.
This is why Cheyenne adopted The Unified Development Code.It keeps everyone on a level
playing field.People moving into town can expect that all Cheyenne development meets certain
minimum standards.
For the council to approve below minimum or substandard developments really upsets the
applecart.
As an added note, Irecently became aware that the Developer has submitted to planning another
version of the same plat which uses a40’street not a 20'private alley.I recall the owner's agent
telling Public Services thatthe plans beforeyou arethe best solution or something similar.Thisis
a much better solution, although it does not completely comply with the UDC.I submit they
already have a better solution.
Again, Iurge you to Deny the Waterford Square2nd Filing Final Plata t the October10,2016City
Council Meeting.
Sincerely,
